fields.performed: boolean; false only when no usable point-pair observations exist
fields.partition_changed: boolean; compares co-membership partitions under canonical and reversed observation order, ignoring numeric cluster labels
fields.affected_observation_count: integer; number of point-pair observations whose co-membership set changes in this one probe
fields.limitation: single order-sensitivity probe; unchanged does not establish unique correspondence

status_rule: If geometry is otherwise available and partition_changed is true, preserve the candidate and add complete_linkage_partition_tie to candidate.reason; status becomes geometry_review.
scope: finite diagnostic, not exhaustive tie enumeration, identity certification, identifier-invariance proof, statistical confidence or visual quality judgement
historical_outputs: Existing saved v1 outputs can lack this additive field. A missing field means this probe was not recorded, not that it passed. No frozen 137-image or 822-setting outputs were regenerated.
